3 bases, Karakol, Cholpon-Ata, Kochkor / Son-Kul area: the moves cost about 8 h 45 in all. It takes these stays to reach the places you named.

6 days are lighter than they should be: Sidequest could not put 22 of the places it found on the map. That is Sidequest's to fix — nothing for you to do.

WHAT THIS PLAN STILL LACKS

Nomadic culture and yurt stay is not in the plan, although the board offers it. A night at Son-Kul with a shepherd family is the signature Kyrgyzstan experience and fits the moderate, guided-transfer style. Keep one of Son-Kul Lake on the Discovery Board and rebuild.

SIGNATURE EXPERIENCES

The trip is built around
I · DAY 4
Jeti-Oguz Gorge
268 min on foot — further than you said you would usually go, but a strong enough fit that it earns the extra travel.
II · DAY 5
Cholpon-Ata Petroglyphs
Open-air field of Bronze Age rock carvings, best seen in the low evening light to avoid heat and buses.
III · DAY 7
Chon-Kemin Valley
Quiet green valley between Bishkek and Issyk-Kul, an alternative route if time allows a detour.
